instruction: Update my Thunderbird account's reply-to address to 'reply@example.com'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring a reply-to email address in Thunderbird account settings. The evaluator checks the mail.identity.id1.replyTo preference in prefs.js to verify the reply-to address is set to 'reply@example.com'. Uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function which can validate any Thunderbird preference.
